div.div: 2 رهّلهُ , inf. n. تَرْهِيلٌ, It (flesh-meat) rendered it (i. e. his flesh) quivering, and flaccid, or flabby: (S, K:) or inflated, or swollen: or swollen without disease: (K: [see 1:]) or it (much sleep) rendered his face swollen, and the parts below, or around, his eyes puffy. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
